documents.text: KnowFlow 的知识库会把文档解析为文本并切分为 chunk，检索结果返回可追溯 citation。混合检索使用词法结果与向量结果进行 RRF 融合。
Python lists preserve insertion order, support indexed access, and are mutable sequences.
The Flutter client uses Dart and calls the FastAPI backend through an ApiClient. Android and HarmonyOS share business UI while platform-specific file pickers are isolated behind a service.
Document ingestion supports TXT, Markdown, PDF, DOCX and PPTX. Empty documents, invalid UTF-8 text and unsupported extensions are rejected.

Repository Learning accepts public GitHub, GitLab and Gitee repositories, performs a shallow clone, analyzes README, dependency files, entry points and source tree, then indexes useful text into a knowledge base.
Quiz submission calculates a score and updates mastery. The quiz creation response does not expose the correct answer before submission.
Long-term memories belong to the authenticated user. Memory supports create, search, update and delete operations with ownership isolation.
Repository import resolves DNS and rejects private, loopback, link-local, multicast, reserved and unspecified addresses. Git redirects are disabled for clone operations.
Study plans contain tasks with due dates. Completing a task updates its completed state and the learning progress shown to the user.
Multi-turn chat reuses the same conversation_id. The backend verifies that a conversation belongs to the current authenticated user before accepting writes.

Qdrant stores chunk vectors with user_id, knowledge_base_id, document_id and chunk_id payloads. Vector retrieval applies an ownership filter and a similarity threshold. Lexical fallback remains available when Qdrant is offline.
The Agent runtime validates tool schemas, dispatches tools through service functions, records agent_runs and tool_calls audit rows, and supports model-driven read and write tool calls.
